fields.description:
2.5mm 16AWG single core cable, Single core cables with copper conductor, solid and insulated with PVC compound layer. These cables are intended for drawing into trunkings or conduits. They may also be used inside fixed, protected installations such as lighting fittings, appliances, switchgears and control gears.

Features

  • Size: 2.5mm Single Core 16AWG
  • Insulation: PVC
  • Conductor: 1  Solid plain copper core
  • Sheath: PVC (Polyvinyl-Chloride)
  • Length: 90 Meters Roll
  • Voltage rating: 300/500 Volts
  • Maximum Current Rating: 18A
  • Temperature rating: 0°C to +70°C
  • Bending radius: 3x overall diameter
  • RoHS approved
  • BASEC and BS6004 approved
